content.comment_body: Q3 output switches ON for a short period during boot, but this only happens when the program is loaded for the first time.
Which [product_name] are you using exactly? I have a 12/24 RCE ([article_no]). This issue does not occur with other models.

You’re not the only one experiencing this issue. Check out this related topic: Ausgangsrelais Q3 schaltet kurz bei Spannungsaufschaltung der [product_name]. If I were you, I would begin a support request, so you can contact [company_name] directly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported that the Q3 output on certain [product_name] devices briefly activates during the initial boot phase, but only when the program is downloaded for the first time. Multiple users confirm this recurring issue, suggesting it’s not isolated. This unpredictable output upon first-time programming raises concerns about hardware reliability and consistent operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the Q3 output to remain OFF during boot and initial programming to maintain reliable and safe hardware performance.
